title: Langley 204

services.name: Trail Rides
services.desc: Langley 204 has direct access to the magnificent Campbell Valley Park (CVP).CVP is a 1400 Acre equestrian focused regional park that has double wide groomed trails suitable to use year round. We have a large selection of well trained and fun horses to ride. We take each riders approximate height, weight, and experience level in order to best match them to our horses. English and Western Saddles available.
